# AgentReputationGraph

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-23

## Definition
A graph structure where nodes are agents and edges carry reputation values, updated via interaction outcomes. Serves as a dynamic topology abstraction that can be optimized for fault tolerance and cooperative task allocation in TCC.
